subject: Insurance
title: Catastrophe Bonds
description: A micro-lesson that makes Catastrophe Bonds usable.

hook.text: A catastrophe bond lets investors bet against disasters. If no hurricane hits, they earn 10%+ returns.

buildup.text: Insurers issue cat bonds to transfer extreme risk to Wall Street.

discovery.text: The cat bond market reached $45 billion in 2023.

twist.text: Cat bonds pay investors when nothing bad happens.

climax.text: Cat bonds connected insurance to capital markets.

punchline.text: $45 billion market. Wall Street now bets on whether hurricanes will hit.

quiz.question: What happens to catastrophe bond investors when a disaster strikes?
